contract.empty_delivery: Emitting an event with no registered listeners succeeds without delivery
contract.registry_stability: An emit with no listeners does not create or mutate the listener registry
contract.event_absence: The emitted event is not inserted into the listener registry merely by emitting it
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus still checks the events permission before processing the emit
contract.source_integrity: The source payload remains unchanged after an emit with no listeners
